hyperchanger.description: HyperChanger takes HyperOS customization to another level, giving rooted Xiaomi users more freedom to shape their phone around their preferences. Built for LSPosed and Vector, it brings extensive tweaks for the Control Center, notifications, lock screen, launcher, volume panel, system settings, and more. Customize layouts, animations, blur effects, Liquid Glass visuals, and hidden system behaviors, all from one place. Designed primarily for HyperOS 4 (Android 17), HyperChanger is still experimental, with feature availability depending on your device and system version.
